hero.headline: Learn it from someone who loves it.
hero.subtitle: Meenty introduces you to volunteers who teach what they know -- writing, jazz, bread, code -- because they love it. No courses, no fees. And when you've grown, you teach the next person. That's the whole idea.
hero.freeSticker: free -- actually free, not "free trial" free
hero.manifesto: Everyone knows something worth passing on. Most of us were just never asked.

mission.heading: to help people learn, share and grow together.
mission.body: We connect people who want to learn with people who are willing to share what they know, creating meaningful connections where everyone has something to give and something to discover.

vision.heading: a world where everyone can learn from anyone.
vision.body: We want to make knowledge more open and human, giving people the chance to discover and connect with others far beyond their usual circles, regardless of where they come from, what they do, who they know or what they have. A world where everyone has access to people who can help them grow, and where everyone can feel that what they know and who they are can make a difference to someone else.

how.heading: How it works
how.note: -- honestly, this is all of it

steps.title: Say it in your own words
steps.body: "I want to write better." "Help me understand jazz." "My plants keep dying." That's the whole search -- no categories to browse, no forms to fill.

steps.title: Meet people who've offered to help
steps.body: We introduce you to a few volunteers who know the subject and chose to be here. You pick who to write to; they decide if it's a match. Nobody owes anybody anything.

steps.title: Then it's just a conversation
steps.body: Chat and video calls, inside Meenty. Ask when you're stuck. Take an afternoon or take a year. When you've grown, you close the loop and send them a ty.

steps.title: Then you pass it on
steps.body: Your goal sentence becomes your first teaching profile. One sprout given for the one you received -- that's how there's always someone to learn from.

people.heading: You don't need 15 years. One sprout ahead is enough.
people.lead: Some volunteers are lifelong experts. Many just finished learning the thing themselves -- and nobody remembers the blank page better than someone who stared at it last month. Instead of star ratings, mentors collect tys: thank-yous from learners that grow leaves on their page.
people.note: that's why it's called meenty, btw
people.caption: example profiles -- meenty opens soon, and one of these could be you

profiles.name: Felipe Vieira
profiles.bio: Fifteen years as an editor. Nothing makes me happier than watching someone stop being afraid of their own first draft.
profiles.quote: I showed up with a novel I'd been 'about to start' for six years. Three conversations later, I had a first chapter.

profiles.name: Ana Duarte
profiles.bio: I finished my first chapter here in March. If you're staring at a blank page, I know exactly how that feels -- and I'll show you what got me unstuck.

values.heading: Our values
values.note: -- four things we keep coming back to

items.title: first step > perfect plan
items.body: We don't need to have it all figured out before we start. We try, we learn, we adjust, and we keep moving. Sometimes the best way to find the way is simply to take the first step.

items.title: sharing = caring
items.body: We share what we know, what we discover, and what might help someone else. We believe that when we share freely, we make things a little easier, a little richer, and a lot more connected.

items.title: people > titles
items.body: We want to see the person before the title. What someone has lived, felt, discovered or cares about can be just as meaningful as what they do for a living. We care about the person, not the label.

items.title: mentor ≡ mentee
items.body: We don't believe learning only goes one way. We can all have something to share and something to learn, sometimes in the very same conversation. There is no one above or below anyone else.

message.heading: Send us a message
message.sub: Questions, ideas, something you'd love to teach -- we read everything.

close.heading: Come for what you want to learn. Stay for what you'll teach.
close.sub: Meenty opens with whoever joins first -- that's you. Leave your email and we'll write once, when the doors open. Until then, we'll be busy planting.

match.heading: You pick. They accept. Then it's just the two of you.
match.lead: When a volunteer says yes, a chat opens -- and everything happens right there. Messages, video calls, that Thursday you keep. And when they help you grow, you send them a ty. It's the only currency in Meenty, and it can't be bought.

loop.heading: Pass it on: the part that makes the garden grow.
loop.lead: Meenty isn't a marketplace with mentors on one side and learners on the other. It's a cycle you join. You arrive with a goal, and you leave it as someone worth learning from -- one sprout ahead of whoever comes next.
